description: This Java source file contains the implementation of the HibernateCohortDAO class, which provides database access methods for Cohort and CohortMembership entities in the OpenMRS platform, utilizing Hibernate ORM for persistence operations.

classes.name: HibernateCohortDAO
classes.description: Implements the CohortDAO interface using Hibernate ORM for database interactions, providing methods to retrieve, save, and delete Cohort and CohortMembership entities.

methods.name: setSessionFactory
methods.description: Sets the Hibernate SessionFactory used for database operations.

methods.name: getCohort
methods.description: Retrieves a Cohort entity by its ID.

methods.name: getCohortsContainingPatientId
methods.description: Finds all Cohorts containing a specific patient ID, optionally filtered by date and inclusion of voided records.

methods.name: getCohortByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a Cohort entity by its UUID.

methods.name: getCohortMembershipByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a CohortMembership entity by its UUID.

methods.name: deleteCohort
methods.description: Deletes a given Cohort entity from the database.

methods.name: getCohorts
methods.description: Searches for Cohorts matching a name fragment.

methods.name: getAllCohorts
methods.description: Retrieves all Cohorts, with optional exclusion of voided entries.

methods.name: getCohort
methods.description: Finds a Cohort by exact name, excluding voided ones.

methods.name: saveCohort
methods.description: Saves or updates a Cohort entity.

methods.name: getCohortMemberships
methods.description: Retrieves CohortMemberships for a patient, optionally filtered by date and voided status.

methods.name: saveCohortMembership
methods.description: Saves or updates a CohortMembership entity.
